items.name: Scale Out & Shard
items.text: Add nodes and split data into partitions or shards so each node processes its share in parallel.

items.name: Data Locality
items.text: Move compute to data because network shuffles are costly. Filter early and broadcast small tables.

items.name: Fault Tolerance
items.text: Failed nodes retry elsewhere. Spark recomputes lost partitions from lineage; HDFS replicates blocks.

items: Scale up rarely fixes skew or many small files.
Neptune is the graph answer; avoid deep traversals in DynamoDB or RDS.
A DAG cannot have cycles; retries use retry policies, not cyclic edges.
Shuffles are the main cost; Redshift distribution keys colocate joined rows.
